About / History

Controls (keyboard)

↑Throttle (hold; it ramps up)
↓Brake (hold; ramps to full pedal, can lock the wheels)
→ / ←GT350: shift up / down (automatic clutch).
BRM: shift up / down, 5-speed H (automatic clutch).
Cadillac: selector N → D → S → L (Hydra-Matic shifts itself)
S or IIgnition: start / stop engine
1 / 2 / 3Select car (GT350 / Cadillac / BRM)
VInside car / Outside (rear)
EEngine bay (3D engine from the sound model’s parameters; drag to turn, pinch / wheel to zoom, double-tap to reset)
XNext sound model (v1 – v4; v3/v4 play the real start-up and shutdown)
BBRM: next engine sound (v8 → v9.1 → … → v9.6 → v9.8 → v9.9 physics models → v8); also the picker next to the cars
ZNext visuals
Ukm/h ↔ mph
A / DSteer left / right (touch: drag sideways on the road)
QDrag strip (1/4 mile) on / off
RRadio (Cadillac)
TReset trip meter
MMute
HAbout / History

Touch / mouse

Brake pedal left, gas right: press higher up the pedal for more. Shift buttons next to the gas. Works with several fingers at once, and with a mouse. Steer by dragging sideways on the road.

Car

Engine sound is synthesised live in the browser (no recordings). The inside sound is a model (exhaust through the body, intake and mechanical noise through the firewall, cabin boom, road and wind noise), not a measured cabin.
